entities.summary: Gustav Pfleger Moravský was a Czech novelist, poet and dramatist. He is generally associated with the Májovci, but was not actually a member of that group. Gustav Pfleger-Moravský was a poets & playwrights from Karasín (1833-07-27, Karasín–1875-09-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
